<p class="lede">I design and build the layer between a language model and the thing it's actually supposed to do — retrieval, agentic execution graphs, context management, and the deployment infrastructure that lets it run under real hardware, compliance, or air-gapped constraints.</p>

<p class="lede">The work spans two registers on purpose: production engineering for organizations that need a system to actually ship, and academic research into the architectures underneath it. Below is how the two connect.</p>

## Core concepts, in practice

<p class="section-sub">Four ideas run through most of the systems I build. Each one exists because a specific engagement demanded it — not the other way around.</p>

<div class="concept-grid">

<div class="concept-card">
<div class="concept-index">01</div>
<h3>Context engineering over brute-force scale</h3>
<p>Treating the model as a stateless reasoning kernel and moving as much capability as possible into the deterministic software around it — token-budget enforcement, dynamic KV-caching, prefix-caching, sliding-window attention.</p>
<div class="concept-proof"><strong>In practice:</strong> got a 14B-parameter open model to production-grade benchmarks at InfinitGraph by engineering the context layer instead of scaling the model.</div>
</div>

<div class="concept-card">
<div class="concept-index">02</div>
<h3>Agentic execution graphs</h3>
<p>Multi-agent systems as deterministic Directed Acyclic Graphs with explicit routing and node-level error handling, so behavior can be audited step by step rather than trusted on faith.</p>
<div class="concept-proof"><strong>In practice:</strong> R&D pipeline and reasoning architecture for InfinitGraph's agentic discovery platform.</div>
</div>

<div class="concept-card">
<div class="concept-index">03</div>
<h3>Hybrid retrieval</h3>
<p>Dense vector search paired with symbolic knowledge structures, because nearest-neighbor retrieval alone quietly breaks down the moment a corpus has real relational structure — citations, patents, regulation.</p>
<div class="concept-proof"><strong>In practice:</strong> self-hosted RAG and vector search architectures built at Qantra.AI for early production clients.</div>
</div>

<div class="concept-card">
<div class="concept-index">04</div>
<h3>State decoupling &amp; sovereign deployment</h3>
<p>Separating logical state (a persistent graph) from ephemeral inference compute, and running the whole stack locally where compliance or infrastructure rules out a hosted API.</p>
<div class="concept-proof"><strong>In practice:</strong> the <a href="work/research/papers/cascade-context-protocol/index.html">Cascade Context Protocol</a> — an open architecture for near-unbounded context under constant memory.</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
